nodes.label: flask
nodes.description: The Flask source package (`src/flask`). The top-level modules hold the WSGI [Flask](node:flask/app.py#Flask) class and the request/app context machinery; `sansio/` holds the I/O-free base classes and `json/` the JSON helpers.

nodes.label: sansio
nodes.description: I/O-free base classes shared with alternative implementations: [Scaffold](node:flask/sansio/scaffold.py#Scaffold), [App](node:flask/sansio/app.py#App) and [Blueprint](node:flask/sansio/blueprints.py#Blueprint). Per its README this code must not do IO or use the Flask globals.

nodes.label: json
nodes.description: JSON support: module-level helpers that delegate to the active app's provider, the pluggable [JSONProvider](node:flask/json/provider.py#JSONProvider) classes, and the tagged serializer used for session cookies.

nodes.label: __init__.py
nodes.description: Public API surface. It only re-exports names (Flask, Blueprint, Config, request/session/g/current_app, helpers, signals, template and JSON functions, Request, Response) from the sibling modules.

nodes.label: __main__.py
nodes.description: Entry point for `python -m flask`; imports `main` from [cli](node:flask/cli.py) and calls it.

nodes.label: app.py
nodes.description: Defines the concrete WSGI application class [Flask](node:flask/app.py#Flask), adding request dispatch, error handling, response creation, URL building, the dev server, and context/test helpers on top of the sans-IO [App](node:flask/sansio/app.py#App).

nodes.label: blueprints.py
nodes.description: The IO-aware [Blueprint](node:flask/blueprints.py#Blueprint), a thin subclass of the sans-IO blueprint that adds a CLI group, static file serving and resource opening.

nodes.label: cli.py
nodes.description: The `flask` command line: locating the app (`--app`, `FLASK_APP`, wsgi.py/app.py), the [FlaskGroup](node:flask/cli.py#FlaskGroup) and [AppGroup](node:flask/cli.py#AppGroup) click groups, dotenv loading, and the built-in `run`, `shell` and `routes` commands.

nodes.label: config.py
nodes.description: Configuration storage: the dict subclass [Config](node:flask/config.py#Config) with loaders for env vars, Python files, objects, data files and mappings, and the [ConfigAttribute](node:flask/config.py#ConfigAttribute) descriptor that proxies attributes to config keys.

nodes.label: ctx.py
nodes.description: Application and request contexts. [AppContext](node:flask/ctx.py#AppContext) is a single class that carries the app, `g`, URL adapter and (when handling a request) the request and session; also holds the `g` namespace class and context-related decorators and predicates.

nodes.label: debughelpers.py
nodes.description: Debug-mode helpers that produce friendlier errors: file-upload enctype mistakes, redirects that drop form data, and a log explaining how a template was (not) found.

nodes.label: globals.py
nodes.description: Defines the context variable `_cv_app` and the `LocalProxy` objects (`app_ctx`, `current_app`, `g`, `request`, `session`) that resolve against the active [AppContext](node:flask/ctx.py#AppContext).

nodes.label: helpers.py
nodes.description: User-facing helper functions (url_for, redirect, abort, flash, send_file, stream_with_context, make_response, ...) that act on the current app/request through the globals, plus small internal utilities.

nodes.label: logging.py
nodes.description: Logger setup for the app: a default stream handler that writes to `wsgi.errors` during a request, and [create_logger](node:flask/logging.py#create_logger).

nodes.label: sessions.py
nodes.description: Session objects and the session interface. [SessionInterface](node:flask/sessions.py#SessionInterface) is the pluggable API; [SecureCookieSessionInterface](node:flask/sessions.py#SecureCookieSessionInterface) is the default, storing signed JSON in a cookie.

nodes.label: signals.py
nodes.description: Declares Flask's own blinker signals in a private namespace. Other modules call `.send()` on them.

nodes.label: templating.py
nodes.description: Jinja integration: the Flask [Environment](node:flask/templating.py#Environment), a loader that searches the app and all blueprints, the default context processor, and render/stream template functions that fire signals.

nodes.label: testing.py
nodes.description: Test utilities: [EnvironBuilder](node:flask/testing.py#EnvironBuilder) that takes defaults from the app, [FlaskClient](node:flask/testing.py#FlaskClient) with session and context preservation support, and [FlaskCliRunner](node:flask/testing.py#FlaskCliRunner).

nodes.label: typing.py
nodes.description: Type aliases for response values, headers and the callback signatures used by the decorators. No runtime logic.

nodes.label: views.py
nodes.description: Class-based views: [View](node:flask/views.py#View) with `as_view()` and [MethodView](node:flask/views.py#MethodView), which dispatches to methods named after HTTP verbs.

nodes.label: wrappers.py
nodes.description: The default [Request](node:flask/wrappers.py#Request) and [Response](node:flask/wrappers.py#Response) classes, extending Werkzeug's with routing info, config-driven size limits, and an HTML default mimetype.

nodes.label: __init__.py
nodes.description: Module-level JSON functions (`dumps`, `dump`, `loads`, `load`, `jsonify`). Each delegates to `current_app.json` when an app is active, otherwise falls back to the standard library.

nodes.label: provider.py
nodes.description: The JSON provider abstraction: [JSONProvider](node:flask/json/provider.py#JSONProvider) base class and [DefaultJSONProvider](node:flask/json/provider.py#DefaultJSONProvider), built on the stdlib `json` with extra type support.

nodes.label: tag.py
nodes.description: Tagged JSON: [TaggedJSONSerializer](node:flask/json/tag.py#TaggedJSONSerializer) and a set of tag classes that encode non-JSON types (tuple, bytes, UUID, datetime, Markup) so they round-trip through session cookies.

nodes.label: app.py
nodes.description: Sans-IO base application class [App](node:flask/sansio/app.py#App): configuration, URL map, registries for blueprints and template helpers, error-handler lookup and URL-building hooks, without request handling.

nodes.label: blueprints.py
nodes.description: Sans-IO blueprint: [BlueprintSetupState](node:flask/sansio/blueprints.py#BlueprintSetupState) and [Blueprint](node:flask/sansio/blueprints.py#Blueprint), which records deferred registrations and replays them onto an app in `register`.

nodes.label: scaffold.py
nodes.description: [Scaffold](node:flask/sansio/scaffold.py#Scaffold), the base class shared by apps and blueprints (routing and handler decorators and their registries), plus `setupmethod` and package-path discovery helpers.

nodes.label: _make_timedelta
nodes.description: Converts an int number of seconds to a `timedelta`; passes `None` and timedeltas through. (A copy of the helper in the sans-IO app module.)

nodes.label: remove_ctx
nodes.description: Decorator used by the deprecation shim: wraps an old-style method so that a leading `AppContext` argument is dropped before calling it.

nodes.label: add_ctx
nodes.description: Counterpart of [remove_ctx](node:flask/app.py#remove_ctx): wraps a base-class method so a missing leading `AppContext` argument is filled in from the current context.

nodes.label: Flask
nodes.description: The WSGI application. Subclasses the sans-IO [App](node:flask/sansio/app.py#App) and implements the request lifecycle: `wsgi_app` pushes a context, `full_dispatch_request` runs pre/post processing around `dispatch_request`, and errors go through the handler methods.

nodes.label: __init_subclass__
nodes.description: For each lifecycle method that now takes `ctx: AppContext` first, checks whether a subclass overrides it with the old signature; if so warns and wraps it using [remove_ctx](node:flask/app.py#remove_ctx) / [add_ctx](node:flask/app.py#add_ctx).

nodes.label: __init__
nodes.description: Calls the sans-IO constructor, creates the app's `cli` [AppGroup](node:flask/cli.py#AppGroup), and, if a static folder is configured, registers the `static` route pointing at `send_static_file` (via a weakref to avoid a cycle).

nodes.label: get_send_file_max_age
nodes.description: Returns the cache `max_age` in seconds from the `SEND_FILE_MAX_AGE_DEFAULT` config value (converting a timedelta), or `None`.

nodes.label: send_static_file
nodes.description: View function that serves files from the static folder with [send_from_directory](node:flask/helpers.py#send_from_directory); raises if no static folder is set.

nodes.label: open_resource
nodes.description: Opens a file relative to the app's root path for reading only (modes r, rt, rb).

nodes.label: open_instance_resource
nodes.description: Opens a file relative to the instance folder; unlike `open_resource`, writing is allowed.

nodes.label: create_jinja_environment
nodes.description: Builds the Jinja [Environment](node:flask/templating.py#Environment) from `jinja_options` (autoescape and auto_reload defaults), then adds `url_for`, `get_flashed_messages`, `config`, and the `request`/`session`/`g` proxies as globals and sets the JSON policy.

nodes.label: create_url_adapter
nodes.description: Binds the URL map to the request's WSGI environ (checking trusted hosts and handling `SERVER_NAME` and subdomain matching), or, with no request, binds to `SERVER_NAME` if configured, else returns `None`.

nodes.label: raise_routing_exception
nodes.description: Re-raises the request's stored routing exception. In debug mode, a non-GET redirect that would drop form data raises [FormDataRoutingRedirect](node:flask/debughelpers.py#FormDataRoutingRedirect) instead.

nodes.label: update_template_context
nodes.description: Fills a template context with values from the registered context processors (app first, then the request's blueprints); values passed to render_template are re-applied last so they win.

nodes.label: make_shell_context
nodes.description: Builds the namespace for `flask shell`: `app`, `g`, plus whatever the shell context processors return.

nodes.label: run
nodes.description: Runs the Werkzeug development server. Does nothing when launched from `flask run`; otherwise loads dotenv files, resolves debug/host/port (using `SERVER_NAME` if set), prints the banner and calls `run_simple`.

nodes.label: test_client
nodes.description: Creates a test client of `test_client_class` (default [FlaskClient](node:flask/testing.py#FlaskClient)) bound to this app.

nodes.label: test_cli_runner
nodes.description: Creates a CLI runner of `test_cli_runner_class` (default [FlaskCliRunner](node:flask/testing.py#FlaskCliRunner)).

nodes.label: handle_http_exception
nodes.description: Handles an HTTP exception: returns it unchanged if it has no code or is a routing exception, otherwise looks up a registered error handler and calls it.

nodes.label: handle_user_exception
nodes.description: Entry point for exceptions raised during a request: shows bad-key details when debugging, delegates HTTP exceptions to `handle_http_exception`, otherwise finds a handler or re-raises.

nodes.label: handle_exception
nodes.description: Handles an unhandled exception: sends `got_request_exception`, re-raises when propagation is on (testing or debug), otherwise logs it and builds a 500 response through any registered 500 handler.

nodes.label: log_exception
nodes.description: Logs an exception to `app.logger` with the request path and method.

nodes.label: dispatch_request
nodes.description: Matches the request to a view: raises stored routing exceptions, answers automatic OPTIONS, else calls the view function for the matched endpoint with the URL arguments.

nodes.label: full_dispatch_request
nodes.description: The main per-request pipeline: marks first request, sends `request_started`, runs `preprocess_request` then `dispatch_request`, routes exceptions to `handle_user_exception`, and finishes with `finalize_request`.

nodes.label: finalize_request
nodes.description: Turns a view's return value into a response with `make_response`, runs `process_response`, and sends `request_finished`. Errors in post-processing are logged instead of raised when coming from an error handler.

nodes.label: make_default_options_response
nodes.description: Builds the automatic OPTIONS response with the `Allow` header taken from the URL adapter.

nodes.label: ensure_sync
nodes.description: Returns plain functions as-is and wraps coroutine functions via `async_to_sync` so WSGI can call them.

nodes.label: async_to_sync
nodes.description: Wraps an async function with asgiref's `async_to_sync`, raising a helpful error if the `async` extra is not installed.

nodes.label: url_for
nodes.description: Builds a URL for an endpoint. Chooses the URL adapter from the active request, active context, or a fresh one from `SERVER_NAME`, resolves a leading-dot blueprint endpoint, injects URL defaults, builds, and falls back to build-error handlers.

nodes.label: make_response
nodes.description: Converts a view return value (str/bytes/iterator, dict/list via JSON, tuple of body/status/headers, Response or WSGI callable) into an instance of `response_class`, raising `TypeError` for `None` or unsupported types.

nodes.label: preprocess_request
nodes.description: Runs URL value preprocessors, then before-request functions for the app and the request's blueprints; the first non-`None` return value short-circuits the view.

nodes.label: process_response
nodes.description: Runs the context's `after_this_request` functions and registered after-request functions, then saves the session through the session interface unless it is a null session.

nodes.label: do_teardown_request
nodes.description: Runs teardown-request functions for the request's blueprints and the app and sends `request_tearing_down`, collecting errors and raising them together afterwards.

nodes.label: do_teardown_appcontext
nodes.description: Runs the app-context teardown functions and sends `appcontext_tearing_down`, collecting errors and raising them together.

nodes.label: app_context
nodes.description: Creates a new [AppContext](node:flask/ctx.py#AppContext) for this app (no request information).

nodes.label: request_context
nodes.description: Creates an [AppContext](node:flask/ctx.py#AppContext) carrying request data built from a WSGI environ, via `AppContext.from_environ`.

nodes.label: test_request_context
nodes.description: Builds a WSGI environ from arguments using [EnvironBuilder](node:flask/testing.py#EnvironBuilder) and returns the matching request context.

nodes.label: wsgi_app
nodes.description: The real WSGI callable: creates and pushes the request context, runs `full_dispatch_request`, converts unhandled errors with `handle_exception`, calls the response, and pops the context in `finally`.

nodes.label: __call__
nodes.description: Makes the app a WSGI application by delegating to `wsgi_app`, so middleware can wrap `wsgi_app`.

nodes.label: default_config
nodes.description: Default values for every built-in config key (DEBUG, SECRET_KEY, SESSION_COOKIE_*, MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH, ...). Copied into the app's [Config](node:flask/config.py#Config) by `make_config`.

nodes.label: request_class
nodes.description: Class used to build request objects; defaults to [Request](node:flask/wrappers.py#Request).

nodes.label: response_class
nodes.description: Class used to build responses; defaults to [Response](node:flask/wrappers.py#Response).

nodes.label: session_interface
nodes.description: Session interface instance; defaults to a [SecureCookieSessionInterface](node:flask/sessions.py#SecureCookieSessionInterface).

nodes.label: cli
nodes.description: The click command group for this app's CLI commands (an [AppGroup](node:flask/cli.py#AppGroup)), named after the app.

nodes.label: Blueprint
nodes.description: Flask's blueprint: the sans-IO blueprint plus CLI group, static file serving and resource opening.

nodes.label: __init__
nodes.description: Forwards all arguments to the sans-IO constructor, then creates an [AppGroup](node:flask/cli.py#AppGroup) as `cli`, named after the blueprint.

nodes.label: get_send_file_max_age
nodes.description: Same as the app method, but reads `SEND_FILE_MAX_AGE_DEFAULT` from `current_app.config`.

nodes.label: send_static_file
nodes.description: View function that serves the blueprint's static folder via [send_from_directory](node:flask/helpers.py#send_from_directory).

nodes.label: open_resource
nodes.description: Opens a file relative to the blueprint's root path for reading only.

nodes.label: cli
nodes.description: The click command group for this blueprint's CLI commands.

nodes.label: NoAppException
nodes.description: `click.UsageError` raised when the app cannot be found or loaded.

nodes.label: find_best_app
nodes.description: Finds an app in a module: an `app`/`application` attribute, the only Flask instance, or the result of calling `create_app`/`make_app`.

nodes.label: _called_with_wrong_args
nodes.description: Inspects the traceback to tell whether a `TypeError` came from calling a factory with wrong arguments or from inside it.

nodes.label: find_app_by_string
nodes.description: Parses a `name` or `name(args)` expression with `ast`, resolves the attribute, calls it if it is a function, and checks that the result is a Flask app.

nodes.label: prepare_import
nodes.description: Turns a file path into a dotted module name, adding the right directory to `sys.path`.

nodes.label: locate_app
nodes.description: Imports a module and returns the app from it, using `find_best_app` or `find_app_by_string`.

nodes.label: get_version
nodes.description: Callback for `--version`: prints Python, Flask and Werkzeug versions and exits.

nodes.label: version_option
nodes.description: The eager `--version` click option.

nodes.label: ScriptInfo
nodes.description: Holds the app import path or factory and lazily loads the app via `load_app`; stored as the click context object.

nodes.label: __init__
nodes.description: Stores import path, factory, debug-flag setting and dotenv preference.

nodes.label: load_app
nodes.description: Loads and caches the app: uses the factory, the import path, or `wsgi.py`/`app.py`; raises `NoAppException` if none; sets `app.debug` from `FLASK_DEBUG` if enabled.

nodes.label: pass_script_info
nodes.description: click decorator passing the `ScriptInfo` object (created if missing) to a command.

nodes.label: with_appcontext
nodes.description: Decorator that loads the app and enters its app context around a command if none is active.

nodes.label: AppGroup
nodes.description: click `Group` whose `command` decorator wraps callbacks in `with_appcontext` (unless disabled) and whose `group` defaults to `AppGroup`.

nodes.label: command
nodes.description: Like `click.Group.command` but wraps the callback with [with_appcontext](node:flask/cli.py#with_appcontext) by default.

nodes.label: group
nodes.description: Like `click.Group.group` but defaults `cls` to `AppGroup`.

nodes.label: _set_app
nodes.description: Callback for `--app`: stores the value on the `ScriptInfo`.

nodes.label: _set_debug
nodes.description: Callback for `--debug/--no-debug`: sets `FLASK_DEBUG` when given explicitly.

nodes.label: _env_file_callback
nodes.description: Callback for `--env-file`: loads dotenv files (needs python-dotenv).

nodes.label: FlaskGroup
nodes.description: The `flask` command group: adds the `--env-file`, `--app`, `--debug` and `--version` options and `run`/`shell`/`routes`, and loads further commands from plugins and from the app's own `cli`.

nodes.label: __init__
nodes.description: Builds the parameter list, sets the `FLASK` env prefix, stores options and registers the built-in commands.

nodes.label: _load_plugin_commands
nodes.description: Once, adds commands from the `flask.commands` entry-point group.

nodes.label: get_command
nodes.description: Looks up a built-in or plugin command; otherwise loads the app, enters its app context, and asks `app.cli`.

nodes.label: list_commands
nodes.description: Lists built-in, plugin and app commands, printing errors if the app cannot load.

nodes.label: make_context
nodes.description: Sets `FLASK_RUN_FROM_CLI` and supplies a `ScriptInfo` as the context object.

nodes.label: parse_args
nodes.description: Before showing help it handles the env-file and app options so the help can list app commands, then parses normally.

nodes.label: _path_is_ancestor
nodes.description: Checks whether one path is an ancestor of another (not used elsewhere in the package).

nodes.label: load_dotenv
nodes.description: Loads `.flaskenv`, `.env` and an optional given file into `os.environ` without overriding existing variables; needs python-dotenv.

nodes.label: show_server_banner
nodes.description: Prints the serving and debug messages unless running inside the reloader.

nodes.label: CertParamType
nodes.description: click type for `--cert`: an existing file, `adhoc`, or an import string resolving to an `SSLContext`.

nodes.label: __init__
nodes.description: Creates the underlying `click.Path` type.

nodes.label: convert
nodes.description: Tries a path, then `adhoc` (needs cryptography), then an `SSLContext` import string.

nodes.label: name
nodes.description: Type name shown in help (`path`).

nodes.label: _validate_key
nodes.description: Callback for `--key`: checks it is consistent with `--cert` and turns the cert into a `(cert, key)` pair.

nodes.label: SeparatedPathType
nodes.description: click `Path` type that accepts several paths separated by the OS path separator.

nodes.label: convert
nodes.description: Splits the value and validates each item.

nodes.label: run_command
nodes.description: The `flask run` command and its options. Loads the app (deferring errors when under the reloader), then starts Werkzeug's `run_simple`.

nodes.label: shell_command
nodes.description: The `flask shell` command: starts an interactive interpreter in the app context with the shell context.

nodes.label: routes_command
nodes.description: The `flask routes` command: prints the URL map as a table, sorted by the chosen field.

nodes.label: cli
nodes.description: The module-level [FlaskGroup](node:flask/cli.py#FlaskGroup) instance behind the `flask` script.

nodes.label: main
nodes.description: Runs the `cli` group.

nodes.label: ConfigAttribute
nodes.description: Descriptor that makes an app attribute read and write a config key, with an optional converter on read.

nodes.label: __init__
nodes.description: Stores the config key name and optional get converter.

nodes.label: Config
nodes.description: A dict with a root path for relative files and loader methods; keys are normally upper-case.

nodes.label: __init__
nodes.description: Initializes the dict from defaults and stores `root_path`.

nodes.label: from_envvar
nodes.description: Loads a config file whose path is given by an environment variable, via `from_pyfile`.

nodes.label: from_prefixed_env
nodes.description: Loads `FLASK_*` environment variables (prefix stripped), parsing values with JSON and supporting nested keys separated by `__`.

nodes.label: from_pyfile
nodes.description: Executes a Python file in a fresh module and loads its upper-case names with `from_object`.

nodes.label: from_object
nodes.description: Copies upper-case attributes from an object or an import string.

nodes.label: from_file
nodes.description: Loads a data file (JSON, TOML, ...) with a given load function and passes it to `from_mapping`.

nodes.label: from_mapping
nodes.description: Updates from a mapping and keyword arguments, ignoring keys that are not upper-case.

nodes.label: get_namespace
nodes.description: Returns the items whose keys start with a prefix as a dict, optionally trimming the prefix and lower-casing keys.

nodes.label: _AppCtxGlobals
nodes.description: The plain namespace object behind [g](node:flask/globals.py#g). Attribute access hits `__dict__`, and it adds dict-like `get`, `pop`, `setdefault`, `in` and iteration.

nodes.label: __getattr__
nodes.description: Looks up `name` in the instance dict, raising `AttributeError` if absent (lets type checkers treat it as a namespace).

nodes.label: get
nodes.description: Returns an attribute or a default, like `dict.get`.

nodes.label: pop
nodes.description: Removes and returns an attribute, like `dict.pop`; raises `KeyError` when missing and no default is given.

nodes.label: setdefault
nodes.description: Returns an attribute, setting it to the default first if absent.

nodes.label: after_this_request
nodes.description: Decorator that appends a function to the current context's after-request list so it runs only for this request; requires an active request context.

nodes.label: copy_current_request_context
nodes.description: Decorator that captures the active context and runs the wrapped function inside a copy of it, so background tasks can use `request` and `session`.

nodes.label: has_request_context
nodes.description: True if a context is active and it carries a request.

nodes.label: has_app_context
nodes.description: True if any [AppContext](node:flask/ctx.py#AppContext) is active.

nodes.label: AppContext
nodes.description: Holds the app, `g`, URL adapter, and optionally the request, session, flashes and after-request functions. Used for requests and CLI commands. `push` makes it current via a context variable and `pop` runs teardown.

nodes.label: __init__
nodes.description: Stores the app, request and session, creates `g` from `app.app_ctx_globals_class`, and creates the URL adapter (a routing HTTPException is stored on the request).

nodes.label: from_environ
nodes.description: Class method that builds a context with a new `request_class` instance for a WSGI environ and the app's JSON module attached.

nodes.label: has_request
nodes.description: True if this context was created with request data.

nodes.label: copy
nodes.description: Creates a new context sharing this one's app, request and session objects.

nodes.label: request
nodes.description: The request object; raises `RuntimeError` in a context without one.

nodes.label: _get_session
nodes.description: Opens the session lazily through the app's session interface, falling back to a null session when none is opened.

nodes.label: session
nodes.description: The session object, flagged `accessed` when read; request contexts only.

nodes.label: match_request
nodes.description: Matches the URL against the map and stores either `url_rule`/`view_args` or the routing exception on the request.

nodes.label: push
nodes.description: Makes this context current (nesting-counted), sends `appcontext_pushed`, and for a request opens the session and then matches the URL.

nodes.label: pop
nodes.description: Checks this is the active context, then on the outermost pop runs request and app teardown and closes the request, resets the context variable, sends `appcontext_popped`, and raises collected errors as a group.

nodes.label: __enter__
nodes.description: Pushes the context so it can be used in a `with` block.

nodes.label: __exit__
nodes.description: Pops the context, passing along any exception.

nodes.label: app
nodes.description: The application this context represents; reached through `current_app`.

nodes.label: g
nodes.description: The per-context global namespace; reached through `g`.

nodes.label: url_adapter
nodes.description: URL adapter bound to the request, or to the app outside a request; may be `None` if binding failed.

nodes.label: __getattr__
nodes.description: Module-level shim: `RequestContext` is a deprecated alias that warns and returns [AppContext](node:flask/ctx.py#AppContext).

nodes.label: UnexpectedUnicodeError
nodes.description: Assertion/Unicode error for unexpected binary or unicode data; used for better error reporting.

nodes.label: DebugFilesKeyError
nodes.description: Error raised for a missing `request.files` key in debug mode; its message explains the form likely lacked `enctype="multipart/form-data"`.

nodes.label: __init__
nodes.description: Builds the explanatory message from the request mimetype and any form values submitted under that key.

nodes.label: FormDataRoutingRedirect
nodes.description: Debug-mode error for a routing redirect (e.g. missing trailing slash) on a non-GET request, which would make browsers drop the body.

nodes.label: __init__
nodes.description: Composes a message with the original and canonical URLs and advice to use the canonical URL or 307/308.

nodes.label: attach_enctype_error_multidict
nodes.description: Swaps `request.files` to a subclass whose `__getitem__` raises [DebugFilesKeyError](node:flask/debughelpers.py#DebugFilesKeyError) when the key exists in the form but not in files.

nodes.label: _dump_loader_info
nodes.description: Generator that yields a text description (class and simple attributes) of a Jinja loader.

nodes.label: explain_template_loading_attempts
nodes.description: Logs how each loader (app or blueprint) tried to find a template, and warns if zero or multiple loaders matched.

nodes.label: app_ctx
nodes.description: Proxy to the current [AppContext](node:flask/ctx.py#AppContext) itself.

nodes.label: current_app
nodes.description: Proxy to the `app` of the current context.

nodes.label: g
nodes.description: Proxy to the `g` namespace of the current context.

nodes.label: request
nodes.description: Proxy to the current context's request; unbound message explains it needs a request context.

nodes.label: session

nodes.label: make_aborter
nodes.description: Instantiates `aborter_class`.

nodes.label: auto_find_instance_path
nodes.description: Finds the instance folder next to the package, or under `<prefix>/var/<name>-instance` for an installed package, using [find_package](node:flask/sansio/scaffold.py#find_package).

nodes.label: create_global_jinja_loader
nodes.description: Returns a [DispatchingJinjaLoader](node:flask/templating.py#DispatchingJinjaLoader) for this app.

nodes.label: select_jinja_autoescape
nodes.description: Autoescape unless the template name has a non-HTML/XML extension; true when there is no name.

nodes.label: debug
nodes.description: Property over `config["DEBUG"]`; setting it also updates Jinja auto-reload if not configured.

nodes.label: register_blueprint
nodes.description: Registers a blueprint by calling its `register(app, options)`.

nodes.label: iter_blueprints
nodes.description: Iterates registered blueprints in registration order.

nodes.label: add_url_rule
nodes.description: Registers a URL rule: derives the endpoint, normalizes methods, adds automatic `OPTIONS`, adds the rule to `url_map`, and stores the view function (refusing to overwrite a different one).

nodes.label: template_filter
nodes.description: Decorator registering a Jinja filter (name optional, usable without parentheses).

nodes.label: add_template_filter
nodes.description: Adds a function to the Jinja environment's filters.

nodes.label: template_test
nodes.description: Decorator registering a Jinja test.

nodes.label: add_template_test
nodes.description: Adds a function to the Jinja environment's tests.

nodes.label: template_global
nodes.description: Decorator registering a Jinja global function.

nodes.label: add_template_global
nodes.description: Adds a function to the Jinja environment's globals.

nodes.label: teardown_appcontext
nodes.description: Decorator registering a function to run when the app context is popped.

nodes.label: shell_context_processor
nodes.description: Decorator registering a shell context processor.

nodes.label: _find_error_handler
nodes.description: Finds the handler for an exception, trying code-specific then generic handlers, blueprint scopes before the app, walking the exception's MRO.

nodes.label: trap_http_exception
nodes.description: Decides whether an HTTP exception is re-raised instead of handled, based on `TRAP_HTTP_EXCEPTIONS` and `TRAP_BAD_REQUEST_ERRORS` (and debug for bad-request key errors).

nodes.label: redirect
nodes.description: Creates a redirect response using the app's `response_class`.

nodes.label: inject_url_defaults
nodes.description: Runs `url_defaults` functions for the app and the endpoint's blueprint chain to fill in URL values.

nodes.label: handle_url_build_error
nodes.description: Tries each URL build error handler; returns the first non-`None` result or re-raises the error.

nodes.label: aborter_class
nodes.description: Class used to create `app.aborter` (Werkzeug `Aborter`).

nodes.label: jinja_environment
nodes.description: Jinja environment class created by `create_jinja_environment`; defaults to [Environment](node:flask/templating.py#Environment).

nodes.label: app_ctx_globals_class
nodes.description: Class for the `g` object of each context; defaults to [_AppCtxGlobals](node:flask/ctx.py#_AppCtxGlobals).

nodes.label: config_class
nodes.description: Class used for the app config; defaults to [Config](node:flask/config.py#Config).

nodes.label: testing
nodes.description: `ConfigAttribute` proxying `config["TESTING"]`.

nodes.label: secret_key
nodes.description: `ConfigAttribute` proxying `config["SECRET_KEY"]`.

nodes.label: permanent_session_lifetime
nodes.description: `ConfigAttribute` for `PERMANENT_SESSION_LIFETIME`, converted to a timedelta.

nodes.label: json_provider_class
nodes.description: Class instantiated for `app.json`; defaults to [DefaultJSONProvider](node:flask/json/provider.py#DefaultJSONProvider).

nodes.label: jinja_options
nodes.description: Extra options for the Jinja environment (class-level dict, empty by default).

nodes.label: url_rule_class
nodes.description: Class for URL rules; Werkzeug `Rule`.

nodes.label: url_map_class
nodes.description: Class for the URL map; Werkzeug `Map`.

nodes.label: test_client_class
nodes.description: Optional custom test client class used by `Flask.test_client`.

nodes.label: test_cli_runner_class
nodes.description: Optional custom CLI runner class used by `Flask.test_cli_runner`.

nodes.label: default_config
nodes.description: Declared here, set by [Flask](node:flask/app.py#Flask): the default config mapping.

nodes.label: response_class
nodes.description: Declared here, set by [Flask](node:flask/app.py#Flask): the response class.

nodes.label: instance_path
nodes.description: Path of the instance folder (given, or auto-detected).

nodes.label: config
nodes.description: The app's config object, built by `make_config`.

nodes.label: aborter
nodes.description: Object that raises HTTP errors; used by `flask.abort`.

nodes.label: json
nodes.description: The JSON provider instance (`json_provider_class(self)`) used by the `flask.json` functions.

nodes.label: url_build_error_handlers
nodes.description: Functions tried in order when URL building raises `BuildError`.

nodes.label: teardown_appcontext_funcs
nodes.description: Functions run when the app context is popped.

nodes.label: shell_context_processors
nodes.description: Functions that add names to the `flask shell` namespace.

nodes.label: blueprints
nodes.description: Dict of registered blueprints by name.

nodes.label: extensions
nodes.description: Dict where extensions store their per-app state.

nodes.label: url_map
nodes.description: The Werkzeug URL map holding all rules.

nodes.label: subdomain_matching
nodes.description: Whether routing considers subdomains.

nodes.label: should_ignore_error
nodes.description: Deprecated hook, `None` by default; if set it can suppress passing an error to teardown handlers.

nodes.label: DeferredSetupFunction
nodes.description: Type alias for a callable taking a `BlueprintSetupState`; the entries of `Blueprint.deferred_functions`.

nodes.label: BlueprintSetupState
nodes.description: Temporary object created while registering a blueprint on an app; holds the merged options (subdomain, url_prefix, name, name_prefix, defaults) and adds rules with the blueprint prefix applied.

nodes.label: __init__
nodes.description: Resolves subdomain, url_prefix, name, name_prefix and URL defaults from the registration options with fallbacks to the blueprint's own values.

nodes.label: add_url_rule
nodes.description: Joins the URL prefix to the rule, applies subdomain and defaults, and calls `app.add_url_rule` with the endpoint prefixed by blueprint name.

nodes.label: app
nodes.description: The app being registered on.

nodes.label: blueprint
nodes.description: The blueprint being registered.

nodes.label: options
nodes.description: The options passed to `register_blueprint`.

nodes.label: first_registration
nodes.description: True if this is the blueprint's first registration on the app.

nodes.label: subdomain
nodes.description: Effective subdomain for the blueprint's rules.

nodes.label: url_prefix
nodes.description: Effective URL prefix for the blueprint's rules.

nodes.label: name
nodes.description: Registered blueprint name.

nodes.label: name_prefix
nodes.description: Prefix of parent blueprint names for nesting.

nodes.label: url_defaults
nodes.description: Merged URL defaults applied to each rule.

nodes.label: Blueprint
nodes.description: Sans-IO blueprint: a collection of routes and handlers recorded as deferred functions and applied to an app when registered; supports nesting.

nodes.label: __init__
nodes.description: Validates the name (non-empty, no dots), calls the scaffold constructor, and stores prefix, subdomain, defaults, CLI group and the nested blueprint list.

nodes.label: _check_setup_finished
nodes.description: Raises if setup methods are called after the blueprint was registered once.

nodes.label: record
nodes.description: Appends a function to be called with the setup state on registration.

nodes.label: record_once
nodes.description: Like `record` but the function runs only on the blueprint's first registration.

nodes.label: make_setup_state
nodes.description: Creates a `BlueprintSetupState`; overridable.

nodes.label: register_blueprint
nodes.description: Registers a nested blueprint to be registered whenever this one is; refuses self-registration.

nodes.label: register
nodes.description: Called by the app. Computes the full name, rejects duplicates, adds to `app.blueprints`, registers the static route, merges handlers, runs deferred functions, wires up CLI commands, then registers nested blueprints with combined prefix, subdomain and name prefix.

nodes.label: _merge_blueprint_funcs
nodes.description: Copies the blueprint's error handlers, view functions and before/after/teardown/url/context-processor registries into the app's registries under the blueprint name.

nodes.label: add_url_rule
nodes.description: Validates the endpoint and view names have no dots and records a deferred `state.add_url_rule` call.

nodes.label: app_template_filter
nodes.description: Decorator registering a template filter on the app when the blueprint is registered.

nodes.label: add_app_template_filter
nodes.description: Records adding a filter to the app on first registration.

nodes.label: app_template_test
nodes.description: Decorator registering an app-wide template test.

nodes.label: add_app_template_test
nodes.description: Records adding a test to the app on first registration.

nodes.label: app_template_global
nodes.description: Decorator registering an app-wide template global.

nodes.label: add_app_template_global
nodes.description: Records adding a global to the app on first registration.

nodes.label: before_app_request
nodes.description: Registers a before-request function for every request of the app, not only the blueprint's.

nodes.label: after_app_request
nodes.description: Registers an after-request function for every request of the app.

nodes.label: teardown_app_request
nodes.description: Registers a teardown-request function for every request of the app.

nodes.label: app_context_processor
nodes.description: Registers an app-wide template context processor.

nodes.label: app_errorhandler
nodes.description: Registers an app-wide error handler through `app.errorhandler`.

nodes.label: app_url_value_preprocessor
nodes.description: Registers an app-wide URL value preprocessor.

nodes.label: app_url_defaults
nodes.description: Registers app-wide URL defaults.

nodes.label: name
nodes.description: The blueprint's name, used as endpoint prefix.

nodes.label: url_prefix
nodes.description: Default URL prefix for the blueprint's rules.

nodes.label: subdomain
nodes.description: Default subdomain for the blueprint's rules.

nodes.label: deferred_functions
nodes.description: Functions recorded to be called with the setup state at registration.

nodes.label: url_values_defaults
nodes.description: URL defaults applied to all of the blueprint's rules.

nodes.label: cli_group
nodes.description: Name of the CLI group for the blueprint's commands, `None` to merge into the app, or the sentinel for the default.

nodes.label: setupmethod
nodes.description: Decorator for setup methods; first calls `_check_setup_finished` so late configuration raises an error.

nodes.label: Scaffold
nodes.description: Base class of apps and blueprints. Holds the handler registries (keyed by None for app-wide or a blueprint name) and provides route and handler decorators.

nodes.label: __init__
nodes.description: Stores the import name, static folder and URL path, template folder, and root path (found from the import name if not given), and creates the empty handler registries (the template context processors start with the default one).

nodes.label: _check_setup_finished
nodes.description: Abstract: subclasses raise when setup is no longer allowed.

nodes.label: static_folder
nodes.description: Property: absolute path of the static folder, or `None`; the setter normalizes trailing slashes.

nodes.label: has_static_folder
nodes.description: Property, true if a static folder is set.

nodes.label: static_url_path
nodes.description: Property: URL prefix for static files; derived from the static folder name when not set.

nodes.label: jinja_loader
nodes.description: Cached property: a `FileSystemLoader` for the template folder under the root path, or `None`.

nodes.label: _method_route
nodes.description: Helper for the verb shortcuts; forbids `methods` and calls `route` with one method.

nodes.label: get
nodes.description: Shortcut for `route(rule, methods=["GET"])`.

nodes.label: query
nodes.description: Shortcut for `route` with the QUERY method.

nodes.label: post
nodes.description: Shortcut for `route` with POST.

nodes.label: put
nodes.description: Shortcut for `route` with PUT.

nodes.label: delete
nodes.description: Shortcut for `route` with DELETE.

nodes.label: patch
nodes.description: Shortcut for `route` with PATCH.

nodes.label: route
nodes.description: Decorator that registers a view by calling `add_url_rule` with the rule and options (an `endpoint` option is popped out).

nodes.label: add_url_rule
nodes.description: Abstract here; [App](node:flask/sansio/app.py#App.add_url_rule) and [Blueprint](node:flask/sansio/blueprints.py#Blueprint.add_url_rule) implement it.

nodes.label: endpoint
nodes.description: Decorator that stores a function as the view for an endpoint name.

nodes.label: before_request
nodes.description: Registers a before-request function for this scope.

nodes.label: after_request
nodes.description: Registers an after-request function for this scope.

nodes.label: teardown_request
nodes.description: Registers a teardown-request function for this scope.

nodes.label: context_processor
nodes.description: Registers a template context processor for this scope.

nodes.label: url_value_preprocessor
nodes.description: Registers a function that can modify URL values before the view runs.

nodes.label: url_defaults
nodes.description: Registers a function that adds default values when URLs are built.

nodes.label: errorhandler
nodes.description: Decorator registering an error handler for a status code or exception class.

nodes.label: register_error_handler
nodes.description: Non-decorator form: resolves class and code, then stores the handler in `error_handler_spec`.

nodes.label: _get_exc_class_and_code
nodes.description: Resolves an HTTP code or exception class to `(class, code)`, validating that it is an exception class; code is `None` for non-HTTP exceptions.

nodes.label: cli
nodes.description: The click command group; set by subclasses.

nodes.label: name
nodes.description: Name of the object; defined by subclasses.

nodes.label: import_name
nodes.description: The package or module name the object belongs to.

nodes.label: template_folder
nodes.description: Template folder relative to the root path.

nodes.label: root_path
nodes.description: Directory used to resolve relative paths.

nodes.label: view_functions
nodes.description: Maps endpoint names to view functions.

nodes.label: error_handler_spec
nodes.description: Nested registry: scope name, then status code, then exception class, then handler.

nodes.label: before_request_funcs
nodes.description: Before-request functions by scope name.

nodes.label: after_request_funcs
nodes.description: After-request functions by scope name.

nodes.label: teardown_request_funcs
nodes.description: Teardown-request functions by scope name.

nodes.label: template_context_processors
nodes.description: Template context processors by scope name; the app scope starts with `_default_template_ctx_processor`.

nodes.label: url_value_preprocessors
nodes.description: URL value preprocessors by scope name.

nodes.label: url_default_functions
nodes.description: URL default functions by scope name.

nodes.label: _endpoint_from_view_func
nodes.description: Default endpoint name: the view function's `__name__`.

nodes.label: _find_package_path
nodes.description: Locates the directory that contains a top-level package or module using importlib specs (handling namespace packages).

nodes.label: find_package
nodes.description: Returns `(prefix, package_path)`: the install prefix for a package under `sys.prefix` or `site-packages`, or `None` for a local package.
